corpus.note: Derived size/raster stress fixtures, not independent papers or real scans. Repeated content adds no independent font diversity; merge does not preserve the original outline. No PDFs are redistributed.

regenerationCheck.note: Vector regeneration changed bytes despite the reproducible writer option. Measured input copies were restored; use their hashes for comparisons.
